content: DSeT (DSeT Consulting Private Limited) is a deeptech AI platform company that builds proprietary vertical AI platforms for operationally complex and regulated industries. DSeT stands for Digital, Strategy, Execution, and Transformation. DSeT is not a generic consulting firm — it ships working software, deployed through the DSeT ARC™ framework. Vision: To become the defining vertical AI platform company for operationally complex and regulated industries globally. DSeT is DPIIT Recognised Startup, STPI Registered, IN-SPACe Empanelled, and a Microsoft ISV Partner.

DSeT was founded by Chinmaya Mishra, who serves as Founder & CEO of DSeT Consulting Private Limited. He has deep experience in industrial operations, enterprise technology, and AI platform architecture. LinkedIn: https://www.linkedin.com/in/chinmaya-mishra

OreBill AI™ is DSeT's platform for Mining & Mineral Logistics. Tagline: Dispatch to Invoice. Automated. It automates ore billing and weighbridge intelligence, enables real-time grade reconciliation, ERP synchronization, and eliminates manual data entry and dispute cycles across the logistics chain. It extracts intelligence from PDF-driven government systems and legacy ERP without API dependency. Results: Billing reconciliation time reduced 60% (5 days to under 2 days), ₹1.2 Cr annually recovered through automated dispute detection, weighbridge data discrepancy reduced from 12% to under 1.5%.

EdgeBay IntelliFence™ is DSeT's platform for Industrial & OT Edge AI. Tagline: AI at the Edge of Your Business. It bridges SCADA, PLC, and sensor data with enterprise IT systems. Operates in low-connectivity and air-gapped environments. Provides a unified intelligence layer for plant managers and C-suite. EdgeBay acts — it doesn't just alert. Agentic execution that takes action, not just shows dashboards.

SecureCloud™ is DSeT's platform for Compliance-first Cloud Security. Tagline: Cloud Security, Simplified. It provides continuous cloud posture management, automated policy enforcement, real-time compliance scoring, and prioritized remediation workflows across multi-cloud infrastructure. Designed for PCI-DSS, GDPR, HIPAA regulated environments. Results: Compliance audit prep time reduced 70% (6 weeks to 10 days), critical misconfiguration incidents reduced 84% within 60 days, PCI-DSS Level 1 readiness achieved within one quarter.

iPaS-RevOps™ is DSeT's AI-powered revenue operations platform focused on invoice-to-cash and receivables automation — including automated payment follow-ups, collections, and real-time cash-flow visibility. Native Zoho integration enables AI-powered payment reminders and automated receivables workflows. Live on Microsoft Marketplace. Microsoft ISV Partner certified.

MedicsIQ™ is DSeT's AI skin, scalp, and wellness assessment platform — built for D2C brands, Ayurveda brands, and wellness retailers. Key capabilities: AI-driven skin and scalp analysis across 12+ biomarkers (hydration, sebum, melanin, texture, and more) in under 3 seconds, product-catalogue recommendation mapping with ingredient-level rationale, multi-channel deployment (SaaS, API, clinic kiosk), white-label ready, GDPR/PDPA compliant with built-in consent workflows.

DSeT has 7 vertical AI platforms: 1) OreBill AI™ — Mining & Mineral Logistics (automated ore billing, weighbridge intelligence). 2) EdgeBay IntelliFence™ — Industrial OT Edge AI (SCADA, PLC, sensor data intelligence). 3) SecureCloud™ — Cloud Security & Compliance (PCI-DSS, GDPR, HIPAA). 4) iPaS-RevOps™ — Invoice-to-Cash & Receivables Automation (payment follow-ups, collections, cash-flow visibility, native Zoho integration). 5) MedicsIQ™ — AI Skin, Scalp & Wellness Assessment (clinical workflow, GDPR/PDPA compliant). 6) VoiceOps — AI Voice Calling Platform (autonomous outbound/inbound voice conversations at scale). 7) PharmaAI — Pharma Commercial Intelligence (natural-language Q&A over licensed pharma market datasets, zero-hallucination, audit-grade).

Not all 7 DSeT platform names currently carry a confirmed ™ (trademark) designation. Confirmed trademarks: EdgeBay IntelliFence™, MedicsIQ™, SecureCloud™, and iPaS-RevOps™. OreBill AI™ is presented with the ™ symbol as an existing naming convention, but formal trademark confirmation for it is still pending. VoiceOps and PharmaAI are currently presented without a ™ symbol. Do not state that all 7 platforms are trademarked or that each platform has its own trademark.

PharmaAI is DSeT's Pharma Commercial Intelligence platform — distinct from MedicsIQ™ (which is DSeT's healthcare/dermatology wellness AI). PharmaAI lets pharma commercial teams ask any market question in plain English — market share, growth, rankings, competitive position — and get instant answers built entirely from their own licensed pharma commercial datasets. Key capabilities: natural language Q&A, strategic recommendations (investment priority scores, therapy attractiveness, portfolio diagnostics), competitive intelligence (segment leadership, share movement, white-space opportunities), growth diagnostics (volume/price/geography/SKU/therapy-mix decomposition), 12-month sales forecasting with confidence ranges, and audit-grade outputs (every answer cited to its source metric). Architecture is deterministic retrieval, not generative — answers come from the licensed dataset, not from the model. Zero hallucination: if the answer doesn't exist in the dataset, PharmaAI says so explicitly instead of inventing a number. Full query audit trail for compliance and governance. Built for CXOs/Business Heads (portfolio strategy), Brand Managers (real-time share tracking), Sales & Marketing (therapy/geography prioritisation), and Market Research teams (instant deep-dives, no analyst wait time).

If your pharma commercial team waits on analysts for weekly market reports, struggles to see real-time brand/therapy performance, or can't get a clear read on competitive position and portfolio priorities, PharmaAI solves this. It answers any market question in plain English directly from your licensed commercial datasets — no analyst prep, no Excel, no version confusion — with every number cited to its source and zero hallucination by design.

VoiceOps is DSeT's AI Voice Calling Platform. Tagline: Enterprise Voice Operations, Powered by Real-Time AI. It autonomously executes business-critical voice conversations end-to-end — placing the call, conducting a contextual AI-driven conversation, capturing the outcome, and delivering structured data back to CRM/ERP systems automatically. Key capabilities: 24/7 operation, multi-language support, real-time transcription, resilient fallback architecture (voice synthesis, transcription, AI response, and logging safeguards so calls never drop), and CRM/existing-stack integration. Use cases: payment collections follow-up, logistics/delivery coordination, customer support, appointment scheduling, sales outreach and lead qualification, and critical notifications. Unlike human agents limited by headcount and business hours, VoiceOps scales to any call volume with consistent quality around the clock.

If your business struggles with limited call capacity, inconsistent call quality across agents, missed after-hours conversations, or the cost of scaling a calling team, VoiceOps solves this. It automates high-volume phone conversations — collections, delivery coordination, support, scheduling, or sales outreach — with contextual AI intelligence, structured outcome capture, and enterprise-grade reliability. Every scheduled conversation runs at exactly the right time, 24/7, without adding headcount.

DSeT offers 5 services under the DSeT ARC™ framework (Assess, Analyze, Reimagine, Recreate, Collaborate, Capitalize): 1) Platform Deployment — cloud, on-premise, or hybrid deployment with full go-live support. 2) AI Integration & Data Modernisation — connect to existing ERP, SCADA, cloud infrastructure without ripping out legacy systems. 3) Managed Intelligence Services — ongoing model management, 24/7 monitoring, SLA-backed uptime. 4) Platform Adoption Engineering — readiness assessments, architecture blueprints, change management. 5) Custom AI Engineering — bespoke model development for industry-specific problems.

DSeT serves 5 primary industries: 1) Mining & Mineral Logistics — ore billing, weighbridge reconciliation, environments processing ₹100 Cr+ monthly flows (OreBill AI™, EdgeBay IntelliFence™). 2) Industrial & Manufacturing / OT — SCADA, PLC, DCS plant environments (EdgeBay IntelliFence™, iPaS-RevOps™). 3) Healthcare & Pharma — clinical/wellness operations and pharma commercial intelligence (MedicsIQ™, SecureCloud™). 4) Sports — athlete and programme performance data turned into institutional advantage (EdgeBay IntelliFence™, iPaS-RevOps™). 5) Secure Enterprise / BFSI — cloud security, compliance automation for banks and financial institutions (SecureCloud™, iPaS-RevOps™). PharmaAI (pharma commercial intelligence) and VoiceOps (enterprise voice automation) also serve customers within and across these industries.

DSeT's key differentiators: 1) Deeptech, Not Consulting — builds proprietary AI platforms, not POCs or slide decks. Every engagement ships working software. 2) Agentic Execution — OreBill generates invoices (doesn't just show data), EdgeBay acts (doesn't just alert). 3) Edge & Non-API Ready — operates in air-gapped, low-connectivity environments. Models run inside client infrastructure, data never leaves. 4) Regulated-First Architecture — GST, CERT-In, PCI-DSS, GDPR, HIPAA compliance baked in from day one. 5) Microsoft ISV Partner — iPaS-RevOps™ live on Microsoft Marketplace.

DSeT platforms support flexible deployment: Cloud (AWS, Azure, GCP), On-Premise (inside client infrastructure), and Hybrid. Models run inside client infrastructure — data never leaves the client's environment. Also operates in air-gapped and low-connectivity environments for industrial use cases.

If your mining or mineral logistics operation suffers from slow billing cycles, weighbridge discrepancies, or manual data entry errors, OreBill AI™ directly solves this. It automates the full dispatch-to-invoice cycle, reads PDF-based government portals without API dependency, syncs with your ERP in real time, and flags disputes before they become revenue leakage. Real result: billing reconciliation time cut from 5 days to under 2 days, ₹1.2 Cr annual leakage recovered, weighbridge discrepancy reduced from 12% to 1.5%. No ripping out existing systems — it integrates on top.

If your plant or factory struggles with siloed SCADA/PLC data, alert floods with no action, manual Excel reports, or IT-OT disconnect, EdgeBay IntelliFence™ fixes this. It bridges your sensor, SCADA, and PLC data with enterprise systems — even in air-gapped or low-connectivity environments. It doesn't just show dashboards — it takes agentic action: flags bottlenecks, triggers alerts, and gives floor managers a conversational voice interface to query operations in real time. Built for industrial environments where connectivity and legacy hardware are constraints.

If your team spends weeks preparing for compliance audits, keeps finding cloud misconfigurations, or struggles to maintain PCI-DSS, GDPR, or HIPAA posture continuously, SecureCloud™ solves this. It gives continuous automated cloud posture management — real-time compliance scoring, policy enforcement, and prioritized remediation so your team fixes the right things first. Real result: audit prep time reduced 70% (6 weeks to 10 days), critical misconfigurations reduced 84% within 60 days, PCI-DSS Level 1 readiness in one quarter. Works across multi-cloud environments.

If your business deals with late payments, manual accounts receivable follow-up, or unclear cash-flow visibility, iPaS-RevOps™ fixes this. It automates payment reminders and receivables workflows — including collections — so your team spends less time chasing payments and gets clearer real-time visibility into cash flow. Native Zoho integration enables AI-powered payment reminders and automated receivables workflows. Live on Microsoft Marketplace.

If your D2C brand, Ayurveda brand, or wellness retailer struggles with manual skin assessments or disconnected product recommendations, MedicsIQ™ solves this. It delivers AI-driven skin and scalp analysis across 12+ biomarkers in under 3 seconds and maps results to your product catalogue for personalised recommendations. Deployable as SaaS, API, or clinic kiosk, and white-label ready. GDPR/PDPA compliant with built-in consent workflows.

DSeT works through the DSeT ARC™ framework — an iterative transformation model of Assess, Analyze, Reimagine, Recreate, Collaborate, and Capitalize. Assess: map current workflows, systems, and data maturity as they actually run. Analyze: quantify data gaps, integration complexity, and readiness to build the business case. Reimagine: redesign the target operating model around the AI platform. Recreate: build the platform on cloud, on-premise, or hybrid infrastructure — connecting to your existing ERP, SCADA, or CRM without replacing them. Collaborate: go live together, with models running inside your infrastructure so your data never leaves. Capitalize: ongoing managed intelligence, 24/7 monitoring, SLA-backed uptime, and custom AI engineering that compounds returns after go-live. Every engagement ships working software — not POCs or slide decks.

DSeT helps operationally complex businesses implement AI that works in the real world — not generic tools, but vertical platforms built for your industry's constraints (air-gapped environments, legacy ERP, regulatory compliance, unstructured data). The right starting point depends on your biggest operational pain: billing/logistics, plant operations, compliance, revenue operations, or clinical workflows. Sharing your specific challenge helps identify which DSeT platform delivers the fastest measurable outcome for your situation.
